notes.title: Version 1.5 (Major) Random Level Generation
notes.content:
Hi Guys

Today we are releasing major new version with very important new features.

- Random Level Generation

Levels are now generated randomly, There is too little chances to play same level again. 

- New Backgrounds added for sanctuary and catacombs.

- Now, We have reapers for each worlds. 
      (5 different reapers enemy characters)

- Now, Wizard can do 2 different special attacks.
          
    When using special power; 
       - Primary attack: Fire strike and fire projectile.
       - Secondary attack: Ice attack and ice projectile.

- Knight's special power projectile now pierces through multiple enemies.

- After Ranger uses dash attack (as ninja), he will have 1 second off invulnerablity (if special power still active).
